title: The Listening Room
description: Trace MOTH’s relay to a vacant switching office. Capture its controller and recover the listening log.
objective: Recover evidence at Authoritative record / Capture controller at Response controller
condition: All required objectives must be secured. Optional archives pay extra. Quiet bonus uses peak trace.
aftermath: The emergency protocol has a name: Night Index. Three people contact you with incompatible plans for the same evidence.

lore.title: The Listening Room / Unsent message
lore.text: MOTH / unverified relay: Trace MOTH’s relay to a vacant switching office. Capture its controller and recover the listening log. The sender asks you to keep the names attached to the evidence; anonymous totals have concealed people before.

lore.title: The Listening Room / Custody note
lore.text: Archive custody, The Listening Room: The emergency protocol has a name: Night Index. Three people contact you with incompatible plans for the same evidence. A second copy carries a hand-written objection to the official disposition.

lore.title: The Listening Room / Private annotation
lore.text: Personal note filed under listening-room: The emergency protocol has a name: Night Index. Three people contact you with incompatible plans for the same evidence. Someone has crossed out the word inevitable. No replacement was supplied.

revelation: The emergency protocol has a name: Night Index. Three people contact you with incompatible plans for the same evidence.

choices.title: Ally with RHEA
choices.description: Build a public evidence chain. Opens the Exposure arc and closes the other alliances.

choices.title: Ally with SABLE
choices.description: Build independent service routes. Opens the Shelter arc and closes the other alliances.
